Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a diffuse reticulonodular pattern involving both lungs, and the CT images confirm widespread interstitial disease with nodules and fibrosis. This diffuse distribution is characteristic of interstitial lung disease (such as lymphangitic carcinomatosis or sarcoidosis), whereas options suggesting upper-lobe predominance (LCH) or isolated lower-lobe findings are inconsistent with the imaging.
